fix: Extend LineageKey to strip date-shaped runs (YYYY[-MM[-DD]], 4-digit-anchored) IN ADDITION to the first dotted numeric run, so dated snapshots of one line share a bucket, while size/tag digits (:8b, :70b, 32b) survive untouched. Then dated snapshots need an ordering: either versionToken already extracts the leading date run for NewestInLineage comparison, or compose a date-aware comparator in front (mirror the FreshnessPolicy alias composition — never modify NewestInLineage's core rule). Risk to guard: any broadening of stripping re-opens capability-class collision; every new stripped shape needs a mustDiffer row proving 8b/70b, mini/base, Flash/Pro still partition.
problem: LineageKey strips only the FIRST dotted numeric run, so date-stamped snapshot ids of the same model line (OpenAI convention gpt-4o-YYYY-MM-DD) land in distinct lineage buckets and PromoteLatest is a permanent no-op for them — the classifier's first pick is frozen (silent staleness, the inverse failure of the downgrade the keyer prevents). Latent, not live: none of the four current CLIs report dated ids; pinned deliberately in TestLineageKey_DatedSnapshotsStayDistinct_KnownLimitation.
